keywords: free and open source android apps

Install FOSS apps outside Google Play
Browse open source mobile app news
summary.what_it_does: F-Droid is an app store and distribution ecosystem for Android focused on free and open source software. The site lets users explore and download FOSS apps and read project news. It also offers app distribution tools for people who want to run their own F-Droid repository, which is listed in awesome-selfhosted as server tooling under AGPL-3.0 with Python, Docker, and deb packaging. The page is available in many languages and includes a link to verify the download.
notable: Store focused on free and open source Android apps
Offers server tools for maintaining an F-Droid repository (AGPL-3.0)
caveats: Page states F-Droid is funded by donations
Page warns that Google is changing how apps are installed on Android, calling F-Droid under threat
